evidence: 'F01 owns the lossless relocation of the existing hand-maintained generated-artifact tables and their focused tests into docs/generated-artifacts.md'
Historical basis: 'Ticket mucky-like-elkhound introduced the current top-level docs index and dead-link gate.'
Sequencing: 'F06 rewrites the documentation landing page after F01' — README rewrite lands after the relocation.
ABSENCE: no statement in F01 about updating existing links pointing at the relocated tables, nor an expand-contract/rollback note for the interim state before F06.
findings.finding: F01 relocates hand-maintained generated-artifact tables (and their tests) into docs/generated-artifacts.md, but the plan does not state that inbound references to the old table location (e.g. from docs/README.md) are updated as part of F01 — yet F01 must pass the dead-link gate introduced by mucky-like-elkhound, and F06 (which rewrites README) lands only afterward.
scenarios: F01's Gerrit dead-link gate fails because README/other docs still link to the tables at their old location after they are moved.
A reader following an existing link after F01 merges but before F06 lands hits a stranded reference.
findings.suggested_fix: Add to the F01 allocation that the lossless relocation includes updating any existing links/references to the moved tables so the dead-link gate passes within F01, independent of F06.
